candidate_rule: Frozen actor, zero command, seven seeded uniform actions; float32 deployment then stable deduplication
scale_bank_source: Authenticated fitting-only bank. Frozen contrast scalars from saved fitting audit; inherited RMS summaries are descriptive and unused for new score factors.
coefficient_selection: No coefficient or normalizer selected in this run; report the entire fixed grid. Any later choice uses development only, then a separate frozen confirmation protocol.
conditional_value_precision: Deterministic full-state rollout; no Monte Carlo sampling. Gaps at/below numerical tie tolerance are inconclusive. No rigorous floating-point error certificate.
stochastic_policy_or_dynamics: Unsupported; stop rather than invent a Monte Carlo estimate
invalid_reference_policy: Evaluation is invalid if reference is unready, nonfinite, or numerically unusable; never claim zero-penalty BCA success
uncertainty_interpretation: Twin-min one-step TD-residual proxy, not a Q1-error coverage guarantee
claim_scope: Prospective second development batch for frozen first-action candidate reranking. No learned-actor benefit, Q-error coverage or normalization approval.
control_factor_rule: Saved fitting candidate contrast C_Q/C_control; no development recomputation
primary_endpoint: Paired true frozen-continuation value gain versus raw-Q1 first-action selection
multiplicity: Pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals, not simultaneous or corrected; no best-method or confirmatory significance claim
preregistration_scope: Protocol frozen after previous development and fitting audits, before any new development labels; not independent confirmation of the earlier study.
actor_distance_interpretation: Squared distance from the frozen actor; geometry only, not behavioral support density or a trained stronger-BC arm
